feeds.title: National Education Alliance for Borderline Personality Disorder Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the National Education Alliance for Borderline Personality Disorder (NEABPD) is to provide education, raise public awareness and understanding, decrease stigma, promote research, and enhance the quality of life of those affected by Borderline Personality Disorder and/or related problems, including emotion dysregulation. NEABPD Blog is a resource for families and people in recovery, education, and training for professionals.

feeds.title: BPD Beautiful
feeds.description: BPD Beautiful is a blog of a proud single mom who is a follower of Jesus, for people suffering from borderline personality disorder and their loved ones.

feeds.title: Florida Borderline Personality Disorder Association Blog
feeds.description: The Florida Borderline Personality Disorder Association is a nonprofit dedicated to educating all Floridians about this highly treatable condition.

feeds.title: Talking about BPD & Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: A blog about BPD (Borderline Personality Disorder), emotional distress and mental health.

feeds.title: BPDvideo.com News
feeds.description: BPDvideo.com offers support, help, information and videos for people living with borderline personality disorder. Get Borderline Personality Disorder news and commentary from the US, UK, Australia, Ireland, India and South Africa. and from around the world.

feeds.title: The Girl with BPD
feeds.description: The Girl with BPD is about the women who is recovering from her BPD battle by tackling the little girl who has always protected her. This is my BPD story . We are not alone and we will all beat this.

feeds.title: Foolish Mutterings
feeds.description: Keep up with updated from Foolish Mutterings.

feeds.title: Make BPD stigma free
feeds.description: Helping those with Borderline Personality Disorder fight the stigma and enjoy their lives for who they are - highly empathetic, compassionate and creative people with beautiful minds.

feeds.title: BPDFamily
feeds.description: BPDFamily provides a support group for family members of those suffering from Borderline Personality Disorder. We help members improve their relationships with loved ones, exit abusive relationships, and work to live more fulfilling lives.

feeds.title: Life after BPD
feeds.description: Life after Borderline Personality Disorder; making a life worth living through love, laughter, positivity and Dialectical Behaviour Therapy.

feeds.title: Half of a Soul Life with BPD
feeds.description: I am a lot of things, but for the purposes of this blog, I am a textbook case of borderline personality disorder (BPD). My intention is that this blog give others with BPD - as well as those that care about them - perspective, insight, and hopefully, even a little bit of hope, help or comfort regarding the nature of this very strange and overwhelming disorder.

feeds.title: Families for BPD Research Blog
feeds.description: We started our journey together after meeting in a BPD family support group. Over time, we have met and talked with many in the mental health field, continually learning and realizing along the way that research into BPD is where answers will be found.

feeds.title: BPD Relationship Recovery
feeds.description: Are you in a relationship with someone suffering from Borderline Personality Disorder and you're trying to figure out what's going on? Have you just gotten out of a relationship with someone suffering from BPD and you're confused, sad and wish that your partner could understand how you really feel about them? You've come to the right place. Enjoy the journey, the stories, the songs, videos and the changes

feeds.title: Life on the Borderline Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about my journey with Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) and Body Dysmorphia.

feeds.title: Beating BPD
feeds.description: Just another girl who's trying to keep her life together. I've overcome an eating disorder and years of emotional abuse & abandonment. Now, I'm trying very hard to keep my job and relationship together.

feeds.title: Flightless Wings
feeds.description: We are all grounded Angels, some of us with broken wings. Trying to hide from the demons that haunt us in our dreams.

feeds.title: Redefining BPD & Mental Illness
feeds.description: This blog is my way of communicating my personal journey and progress towards leading a healthy and happy life. It's a messy, maybe inconsistent journey, but a hopeful one nonetheless. I hope that by putting my realities of BPD into words, that I can help validate and support others on their own pursuit towards happiness. I've come a long way, so reach out and help me create a positive community that can offer hope and inspire progress.

feeds.title: Life in a Bind
feeds.description: Borderline Personality Disorder, Generalized Anxiety Disorder, and my therapy journey. This blog exists for many reasons. It's part of my ongoing recovery and part of my therapy it's a way of processing life, sessions, relationships. It's a way of connecting with other people and feeling less alone when it comes to my experiences of mental illness.
